measurements: exact saved guard replay for all PARTIAL groups
BINARY and exact persisted glyph intersections
8-connected source gray<group-background components before and after staff-context/glyph removal

controls.selection_inputs: graph geometry, processed support geometry and group placement only; never source gray, BINARY values or guard outcome
controls.exclusion: any symbol region bbox expanded 6 pixels, staff-context, or processed support; reject entire translated bbox plus 5px ring
controls.population: all fully on-page support-bbox origins (8+16k,8+16j), with full 5px ring and no exclusion hit
controls.selection: three eligible placements nearest original bbox origin by squared distance then y,x; three remaining row-major placements
controls.geometry: translate exact support, core, fringe, attachment analysis regions and related attachment support; unchanged radius2/radius4 adjacency and median distance3..5 rectangular ring
controls.report: all candidate population sizes, missing samples, placement coordinates, tested guard denominator, trigger rate, source intensity/contrast and BINARY/glyph support; controls are geometric blank candidates, not labeled ground truth
controls.synthetic: uniform white must not trigger; one-gray-level connected tail on white must trigger; dark connected tail must trigger

categories: mutually exclusive precedence: exact persisted symbol glyph intersection; remaining BINARY ink; remaining contrast1..7 LOW_CONTRAST_BACKGROUND_CANDIDATE; residual SOURCE_ONLY_UNRESOLVED. No threshold-derived ground truth or ownership. Also export nonexclusive glyph kinds and original attribution.
connectivity: 8-neighbor gray<each group's background; count remote pixels sharing component with group support and staff, repeat after removing staff-context plus staff glyph. This is topology only, never component ownership.
decision: READY_FOR_CONTINUATION_GUARD_FIX only if controls demonstrate non-musical guard triggers and independent support/topology separates every residual category sufficiently to specify a fail-closed structural fix without guessed ownership; otherwise NEEDS_MORE_CONTINUATION_EVIDENCE
instrumentation: wall seconds and process peak RSS measured separately from deterministic scientific JSON; no runtime budget estimate presented as measurement
restrictions: no admission/guard/ownership changes; no nearest ownership; no FullAcceptance; no runtime replay; no scores edited
